text: Coverage: On the on-prem Linux host hoth, a user created after compromise would be evidenced by useradd command telemetry in osquery:results and by later appearance in Unix:UserAccounts snapshots; both were searched, while cloud bootstrap user-creation artifacts had already been ruled out as a different act on EC2 hosts.

Selection: The created user is tomcat7 because both complete hoth useradd proc_events name tomcat7 in the cmdline, with the successful later execution run by root, and tomcat7 is the only Unix:UserAccounts entry on hoth with reduced snapshot presence (2 of 5) rather than the 5 of 5 seen for pre-existing accounts.
rival: Rival usernames are all other hoth accounts present in Unix:UserAccounts, plus tomcat8 as the actor of the earlier failed useradd attempt; the complete useradd raw events and full 34-row hoth Unix:UserAccounts listing ruled them out.
